description: Local MCP for automated Power Automate flow editing, validation, run and rollback.
name: io.github.kaael1/mcp-power-automate

provenance.notes: Publisher-provided MCP Registry metadata. Pricing is local/self-hosted; Microsoft Power Automate licensing and connector quotas remain external to this MCP package.

pricing.free_tier: Local MCP package; external Microsoft licensing may apply.

sla.rate_limit: local process; bounded by Chromium session, bridge availability, and Microsoft Power Automate service limits

conditions: command mutates a Power Automate flow
command invokes a trigger callback URL
command adds or creates Dataverse solution components
approval.human_readable: Inspection and validation can run without extra approval; flow mutation, trigger invocation, and solution writes should be gated by the MCP client's local approval policy.

operational_constraints.policy_notes: ASM exposes pre-call policy inputs only; the MCP client remains responsible for enforcing approval and safety boundaries.
